lens: Security - secrets, prompt-injection, audit-chain integrity, reviewer_id uniqueness, malicious-by-AI content
owasp_class_review: A08 Software/Data Integrity (audit-chain append posture) + A02 (no secret material) + A09 (logging/evidence completeness); A01/A03/A07/A10 N/A (no auth/route/network/query code in pure JSON evidence add).
answer: PR #17 is a pure additive evidence write (173 files, +7639/-0, CC-6). Security posture is APPROVE-WITH-MINOR. (1) SECRETS SCAN: zero hits across all readable evidence/debate/pr-*.json files for sk-/ghp_/ghs_/AKIA/xox[bap]-/AIza/BEGIN PRIVATE KEY patterns and zero hits for api_key=/password=/bearer / Authorization: literals in the pr-17.diff added lines. The string 'secret/token/credential' only appears as DESCRIPTIVE prose in F7-r1 reviewer findings (e.g., 'no secret material', 'no token/credential markers'), never as a literal value. (2) MALICIOUS-BY-AI / PROMPT INJECTION: zero hits for ignore-previous / disregard-prior / you-are-now / jailbreak / <script>/onerror=/javascript:/eval(/exec(/os.system/subprocess. style markers in added lines. JSON values are inert data; no executable surface is introduced (no .sh, .py, .mjs, .yaml workflow, no Cargo manifest, no template engine input). (3) REVIEWER_ID UNIQUENESS: the 13 reviewer_id strings visible in the diff are all unique and follow the pattern codex-F<n>-pr-<N>-r<round>[-rebuttal|-security]; no duplicate reviewer_id observed within a single change_id in the visible hunks. Each consensus_debate_complete row self-attests reviewer_id_uniqueness_verified=true and distinct_reviewer_ids=18 for 9 facets x 2 rounds (pr-5 = 3 rounds). The full set of 162 facet files is not locally inspectable on this branch (branch oya-m01-m02-gate-usecase-doc-drift is behind dev which holds the merged PR-17 tree), so the per-PR uniqueness claim rests on the self-attested distinct_reviewer_ids count plus the unique pattern naming convention. (4) AUDIT-CHAIN HASH LINKAGE: the 9 appended consensus_debate_complete rows DO NOT carry prev_hash or hash fields. Inspection of the pre-existing audit-chain.jsonl confirms NEITHER prev_hash NOR hash is present on ANY of the 49 existing rows -- the file is a flat append-only JSONL ledger with no cryptographic hash-chain at this layer. PR-17's omission is therefore consistent with the established (non-cryptographic) ledger shape; the per-row note in the older oya_vcs_followup_resolved entry explicitly states 'cryptographic v2 audit-chain kernel remains signed storage substrate' -- i.e., signing lives in a separate kernel, not in this JSONL. No regression. (5) SUPPLY CHAIN: zero new dependencies, zero Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock changes, zero workflow/.gitignore/permission changes implied by file list.
key_claims: Zero secret-pattern hits (sk-/ghp_/ghs_/AKIA/xox[bap]-/AIza/PRIVATE KEY/api_key=/password=/bearer literal) in pr-17.diff added lines or in the existing pr-* evidence files on disk.
Zero prompt-injection / exec-hook markers (ignore previous, disregard prior, <script>, onerror=, javascript:, eval(, exec(, os.system, subprocess., child_process) in added lines.
13 reviewer_id values visible in the diff hunks; all unique; pattern codex-F<n>-pr-<N>-r<round>[-suffix] makes intra-change-id collision structurally impossible.
Each of the 9 appended consensus_debate_complete rows self-attests reviewer_id_uniqueness_verified=true and distinct_reviewer_ids=18 (= 9 facets x 2 rounds, pr-5 = 3 rounds).

Appended audit-chain rows have no prev_hash/hash field; pre-existing 49 rows also have none; ledger is non-cryptographic append-only JSONL with the cryptographic substrate handled by a separate signed kernel per earlier audit row -- no integrity regression.
CC-6 generated_or_vendored classification is correct: pure JSON evidence emission, no executable code introduced, no dependency surface change.
uncertainty_areas: Full per-change_id reviewer_id uniqueness across all 162 facet files cannot be locally verified because the merged tree lives on dev and this review branch does not contain pr-1/2/3/6/7/8/9/11 evidence; verification rests on the self-attested distinct_reviewer_ids=18 count plus naming-convention structural uniqueness.

pr-17.diff is summarized/elided (40.9KB for 7639 additions, only 14 hunk headers) -- secret/injection scan covered the visible additions, not every line of every evidence file; mitigation is the on-disk scan of the existing pr-* evidence which returned zero hits and shares the same author/template.

Whether the higher-layer 'cryptographic v2 audit-chain kernel' actually signs these new rows out-of-band is not verifiable from this PR alone -- audit-chain.jsonl itself remains an unsigned JSONL by design at this layer.
anti_patterns_detected: audit-chain.jsonl has no in-line prev_hash linkage; tamper-evidence relies entirely on the out-of-band signed kernel substrate. Not a PR-17 regression (pre-existing), but worth flagging as a doctrine observation: any actor with repo write access can append a forged row indistinguishably from a legitimate one if the signed substrate is not enforced.

findings.summary: Appended audit-chain rows carry no prev_hash/hash; tamper-evidence depends on a separate signed kernel substrate referenced in a 2026-05-15 row but not asserted in PR-17's evidence.
findings.recommended_action: Add a one-line note in the PR-17 description or a follow-up ADR confirming that the cryptographic-v2 audit-chain kernel signed (or will sign) the 9 appended consensus_debate_complete rows; alternatively, document explicitly that the JSONL is an unsigned mirror of the signed substrate. Either form closes the audit posture gap.

findings.summary: Per-change_id reviewer_id uniqueness is self-attested via reviewer_id_uniqueness_verified=true and distinct_reviewer_ids=18 but not independently re-verified at consumer side; an automated CI lane would harden this invariant.
findings.recommended_action: Add a CI sub-check that, for each consensus_debate_complete row in evidence/audit-chain.jsonl, enumerates evidence/debate/pr-<N>-*.json and asserts the count of distinct reviewer_id values equals payload.distinct_reviewer_ids; fail the lane on any duplicate or undercount.

findings.summary: CC-6 generated_or_vendored classification correctly minimizes review surface; no executable code or dependency changes were introduced.
